world_companies.name: World companies — the planets of Agent World
open: venture separation — Notion open question on M3 (one world per venture vs planets in one world)
rules: Zone map derived, never hardcoded: the overlay builds planets from this key and towns from ops_clients at scan time; npm test greps overlay code for company and client names and fails on a hit (V-U12)
A company with substrate null renders as an empty planet carrying its name and 'no substrate yet' — no runs, no towns, no badges, no reads; it costs nothing at rest
Every run is placed by its client: client → the company whose clients list names it, else the home company; client null → the home campus (Tellefsen HQ). No run is ever placed by actor (Annex III)
Adding a company is one entry here; its colony file is created on first render. Removing one deletes the entry; the file stays until cleaned by hand

The M3 venture-separation question (one world per venture vs planets in one world) is open in Notion and nothing here pre-empts it. This key survives either answer: status active + substrate for a co-rendered planet, status sibling + world_url for a separately deployed world the home planet links to
Renderer holds no state: this key and ops_clients are read; only the colony files are written

world_pack names the World Pack a planet wears (RA Component 10, Decision 2026-09-06 🟡 Working): a folder overlay/packs/<world_pack>/pack.json in the fork declaring skin, rooms, names and the layout file. The renderer reads the id here and loads the pack files; absent → tellefsen-campus, the default for Tellefsen SPC and its ventures. A client town wears its company's pack unless ops_clients.world_branding.pack says otherwise (that column is M3 work — the first client town). A pack names rooms, never clients. Switching this value swaps skin, rooms and names with no code change — that swap is part of V-U12

automations.name: Client Update Agent (single daily scheduled task, day-of-week dispatcher)

automations.trigger_desc: ONE Claude Code cloud scheduled task (Max plan cap = 3 daily slots, kept tight). Cron `0 3 * * 0,1,3,4` fires Sun/Mon/Wed/Thu at 03:00 UTC = 07:00 Muscat year-round. The runner `prompts/run-client-update.md` reads day-of-week and dispatches to one of four logical slots: Sun → Gulf Look-Ahead, Mon → Nordic Look-Ahead, Wed → Gulf Proof of Progress, Thu → Nordic Proof of Progress. Other days exit immediately. Decoupling fire time from send time is intentional: agent only drafts, Christoffer reviews in his morning, n8n delivers on approval at the desired client local time. automations.name: Gate Reconciliation Sweep
automations.platform: Cowork (Tellefsen Compass MCP + Airtable MCP + Notion MCP)
automations.trigger_desc: CREATED in Cowork 2026-09-06 (Christoffer) as ONE task: every day at 13:30 Muscat. As of 09:58 Muscat 2026-09-06 no gate-reconciliation ledger row has been seen yet — the first row (Run now, or the 13:30 fire) is the Cowork half of M0 acceptance; if a manual run wrote nothing, check the task's run log for step 0 (the Compass connector must be enabled on the task). Cowork's scheduler takes one time per task; three-a-day is not needed — gate_passed.at is read from the surface, so time-to-tap is independent of sweep frequency; only ? badge latency depends on it, up to a day, until the Worker write-gate at M1. Model: Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5 if no Haiku in the picker (RUN_GOVERNANCE_RULES.models). Closes the Phase 0 gap where a tap landing after the session never reaches the Run Ledger. Mapping and thresholds live in ops_config RUN_GOVERNANCE_RULES.late_tap_mapping — the prompt carries none. Retires at M1 when the Compass Worker write-gate emits gate_passed on airtable_update_record(pending_approval) status changes; then it runs only for decision gates. Prompt: Notion 'Cowork jobs — Run Ledger (2026-09-05)' §1. Skill row: gate-reconciliation.

automations.name: Meeting Intelligence Sweep
automations.platform: Claude (Plaud MCP + Notion MCP) — Cowork scheduled task + session hook
automations.trigger_desc: PLANNED — activates when the Plaud MCP is connected (device arriving). Three entry points, one processing contract (meeting-postprocess v2): (1) Session hook — any session opening delivery work on a client first checks Plaud for unswept recordings on that client and processes them before the work; (2) Scheduled sweep — Cowork task at 13:00 + 18:00 Muscat, Sun–Thu, processes ALL unswept recordings; (3) Manual — 'process now / process the [client] meeting'. Idempotency via ops_config MEETING_SWEEP_STATE (last processed recording timestamp + IDs). Supersedes the Zapier 'Meeting Ended → Transcription' Zap at cutover. Design: Notion 'Meeting Intelligence OS — Design & Build Plan'.
